exercise: Junior AI Engineer take-home, alternative G (Business UI operator), starter pack 2026-10-02

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude app agentic session (cloud workspace with shell and file tools), configured model claude-opus-5-5. Default settings; no custom configuration files were created for it. Hosted session settings are not exportable.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: No editor plugins or extensions were used for this exercise.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Anthropic claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 by default; max_tokens 1024; forced single tool call per turn; 60 s timeout; 2 SDK retries. Temperature is the provider default because anthropic SDK 1.11 exposes no sampling parameters. OpenAI adapter (gpt-4.1-mini default, temperature 0) exists but was not exercised.

skills.notes: starter-pack skill generate-assignment-data was read for its guidance but not installed or run; the added fixtures R6-R9 were handwritten (method recorded in data/extra-requests.json).

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: No CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md or subagent definitions. The application's own agent instructions are the system prompt listed under prompts_and_rules.

prompts_and_rules.notes: System prompt loaded at runtime; its sha256 is stored in every run.json. Tool definitions (select_option, fill_field, click_button, finish) are in actions.py TOOLS.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: The application's tool surface: four tools, a guard that validates every action, an off-portal network block, a 12-step limit and a 2-save limit. No MCP servers.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Environment variable names only. API keys are read from the environment and never written to run records. The development session's permission settings are hosted and not-exportable.
